definitions.explanation: A length of time with defined start and end points.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}は{来週|らいしゅう}からです。
examples.english: The exam period starts next week.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{期間|きかん}{働|はたら}いた。
examples.english: I worked for a long period.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{期間|きかん}は1{年|ねん}です。
examples.english: The contract period is one year.

notes:
{期間|きかん} refers to a span of time with a defined beginning and end.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}: during the period
- {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}: limited time (offer)
- {有効|ゆうこう}{期間|きかん}: validity period
- {保証|ほしょう}{期間|きかん}: warranty period
- {試用|しよう}{期間|きかん}: trial period
- {契約|けいやく}{期間|きかん}: contract term

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {長|なが}い{期間|きかん}: a long period
- {短|みじか}い{期間|きかん}: a short period
- {一定|いってい}{期間|きかん}: a fixed period

RELATED WORDS:
- {期限|きげん}: deadline, expiration date
- {時期|じき}: time, season, period
- {間|あいだ}/{間|かん}: duration
